reason: The patch adds Javadoc reading "Returns {@code true} if {@link #canView()} returns {@code true}" on `void requireView()` (ClientPermissionEvaluator.java:95-98) and the equivalent on `void requireViewClientScopes()` (ClientPermissionEvaluator.java:100-103). The implementations return nothing and throw ForbiddenException when the check fails (ClientPermissions.java:292-296, 505-509).
